Agenda #1: The meeting approved the 2025 Annual Report, the Board of Commissioners' oversight report, and the audited financial statements while granting a full discharge to the Directors and Commissioners. This approval included the audit performed by Rintis, Jumadi, Rianto & Rekan.
Agenda #2: Shareholders approved a net profit distribution of USD 76,063,685, allocating USD 45,638,211 as cash dividends and the remainder as retained earnings. Dividends are scheduled for payment on June 26, 2026, to shareholders of record as of June 12, 2026.
Agenda #3: The Board of Commissioners was authorized to determine the 2026 honorarium for Commissioners and salaries for Directors following recommendations from the Governance, Nomination, and Remuneration Committee. This decision became effective immediately upon the meeting's conclusion.
Agenda #4: The meeting appointed Yusron Fauzan and the firm Rintis, Jumadi, Rianto & Rekan (PwC) to audit the 2026 financial statements. The Board of Commissioners was granted authority to set audit fees and appoint a replacement if the designated parties cannot fulfill their duties.
Agenda #5: The company reported that all proceeds from the 2024 Limited Public Offering were fully utilized for working capital as of December 31, 2025. This agenda item was for reporting purposes only and did not require a formal vote.
Agenda #6: The meeting accepted the resignations of Emily Olson and Christopher McCleave, reappointed Kristina Gauthier as Vice President Commissioner, and appointed Patricia Renee Pegues and Adam MacMillan as Commissioners. The new Board of Commissioners composition was finalized with terms ending between 2027 and 2029.
